entities.summary: Rodolfo Biagi was an Argentine orchestra conductor, composer, and pianist whose nickname was "manos brujas" and who is considered an important figure associated with tango music. Rodolfo Biagi was a composers & musicians from Buenos Aires (1906-03-14, Buenos Aires–1969-09-24). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
